messages:
elaine: Thanks for joining the AH Q&A. Quick follow-up thread to capture clarifications so folks aren't chasing chat: 1) exact GA window for Dedicated (Ana said Q3) 2) who fields early/beta customer interest 3) owner for the autoscaler runbook + migration guide so we can hand to SEs and customers.

ana: Clarify: GA target is late September. We will open committed capacity signups on July 15th (mid-July). Pricing tiers and partner discounts are still being finalized with finance; I'll post the managed-pricing doc when signed off. Private/VPC options continue in parallel for regulated customers.

youssef: I'll take the autoscaler runbook + migration guide. Plan: draft PR in infra/docs by next Tue with examples and a 'preflight checklist' for customer migrations. Will include recommended flags and a sample helm/terraform snippet.

nick: I'll author the SLO dashboards and add the bpf+latency panels. ETA: this Friday. Will also add a small sample alert policy for "dedicated-backed-saturation" to call out autoscale pressure.

maya: Legal ask: for committed contracts we need standard terms for data residency and liability. Please loop legal@redwood.com when you're prepping partner comms.

tara: I'll take inbound beta requests and keep a weekly digest. Please have customers email sales@redwood.com with subject 'dedicated-early' so I can batch them. I'll start a shared sheet for prioritization.

elaine: A couple more clarifications for public comms: will there be a documented SLA at GA? Ana: yes, basic uptime SLA and latency targets will be published with GA notes, but exact percentages are in final review.

youssef: Repo and docs WIP: https://git.redwood/infra/dedicated-migration (will add runbook + helm snippets). Snippet of recommended runtime flags I'm testing locally:
```
--batch-window-ms=8
--max-batch-size=192
--kv-cache-ttl=3600
```

deploy-bot: Notice: "dedicated-ga-planning" doc updated by ana 1h ago  changelog: 'signup date and SLA placeholder added'

elaine: Action items (owners + ask):
- ana: publish confirmed GA + signup comms by Mon (owner: ana)
- youssef: runbook + migration guide PR by Tue (owner: youssef)
- nick: dashboards + alert policy by Fri (owner: nick)
- tara: weekly beta-interest digest starting next Wed (owner: tara)
- ana + maya: loop legal/finance on pricing/terms thread (owners: ana, maya)
I'll convert these into Asana and tag owners. If anyone needs to be added to these threads ping me. Thanks everyone :rocket:
